title: Next speaker
description:
The upcoming session. Three shapes are rendered by <NextSpeaker>:

1. name + institution + date -> a "Save the date" message
2. ...plus title, abstract, bio, time, location, calendarLink -> the full session card
3. message on its own -> that custom message

Leave the file as {} when nothing is scheduled.

$schema.description: Path to this schema. Keep it — it is what makes these descriptions show up in the editor.

date.description: ISO date, YYYY-MM-DD. Displayed as e.g. "Monday 21st September 2026" — never write the display form by hand.

title.description: Talk title. Adding this (with abstract, bio, time, location and calendarLink) switches the save-the-date message to the full session card.

abstract.description: Talk abstract. Write links as [link text](https://example.com) — they are expanded into styled links that open in a new tab. Raw HTML is also allowed (a, span, div, br, ul, li, strong, em, i, p) and is sanitized by <SafeHtml>.

bio.description: Speaker bio. Same rules as abstract: [link text](https://example.com) for links, HTML allowed.

time.description: Start time as shown next to the date, e.g. "4pm UK time". Dropped when the talk is archived.

location.description: Where the talk happens, e.g. "Online and in-person at [the Turing Institute](https://maps.app.goo.gl/...)". Dropped when the talk is archived.

calendarLink.description: URL of the calendar invite (with the Zoom details). Dropped when the talk is archived.

message.description: A custom message to show instead of any speaker details. Supports [link text](https://example.com) and HTML.

skills.description: 2-4 short lowercase Spanish topic tags. Usually left until after the talk, on the archived session.

linkButtons.description: Extra buttons on the session card. `npm run post-talk` appends the "View slides" one for you.
